description: How often a named long-distance train in Poland (e.g. "Flisak", "Kaszub", "Podhalanin" or its number, e.g. "54102") arrived on time over the last 30 days: on-time share, typical delay, cancellations. Covers about 30 named PKP Intercity trains; for other trains use poland_route_punctuality.
name: poland_train_punctuality
title: Punctuality of a named train in Poland
